## Lecture outline (draft)

The vorticity equation and the stream function, solving the Poisson equation with the FFT, the pseudo-spectral method and dealiasing, the Reynolds number and grid resolution, acceleration with Numba.

- **Problem:** Flow of an incompressible fluid: the Taylor–Green vortex (the reference), the Kelvin–Helmholtz instability, two-dimensional turbulence.
- **Tools:** the pseudo-spectral method, the 2/3 rule, time integration, reuse of the Poisson solver and FFT from lectures 4 and 7.
